allowPlayers.name: Players can configure their items
allowPlayers.hint: Let players configure the items they own from the item description. The Game Master can always do it.

aiEnabled.name: Use the local AI
aiEnabled.hint: Send the sentences the rules do not understand to a local Ollama model.

ollamaUrl.name: Ollama address
ollamaUrl.hint: Address of the Ollama server, as seen from the Game Master's browser.

ollamaModel.name: Model
ollamaModel.hint: Ollama model used for the AI. Leave on automatic to pick the best installed model.

aiTimeout.name: AI time limit (seconds)
aiTimeout.hint: After this delay the configuration continues with the rules alone.

Button.LockedPack: This item is in a locked compendium. Unlock the compendium to configure it.

errors.wrongSystem: Item Configurator requires the dnd5e system.
errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to configure this item.
